1. **Statins for the prevention of dementia.**
   Authors: Bernadette McGuinness, David Craig, Roger Bullock, Peter Passmore
   Journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
   Publication Date: 2009-06-23
   PMID: 19370582
   Abstract: This is an update of a Cochrane review first published in 2001. At that stage there was insufficient evidence to recommend statins for the prevention of Alzheimer's disease (AD). The scope of this review has been expanded to include all forms of dementia.
   URL: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19370582/
